candidates.name: 01-simplified-mascot
candidates.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished square desktop app icon candidate for SpriteLens, based on the attached mascot reference (Image 1 is a character identity and palette reference). Preserve its recognizable green creature identity: very large cream face, dark oval eyes, small zigzag mouth, pink cheeks, tall green ears with coral red tips, playful friendly expression. Flat vector-like raster art, precise smooth edges, consistent bold dark forest-green outline, limited palette, one simple shadow at most. Must work when reduced to 32px. No words, lettering, labels, watermark, mockup, presentation board, or multiple icons. One standalone centered icon, square 1:1 image. Muted pale sage-green background extends fully to all four canvas edges, no outside white border, no baked rounded-square frame; keep the full character within safe margins. Direction A: refine the full-body mascot. Enlarge its face relative to its small compact body. Keep both little front paws and a single simplified leaf-like tail curving behind on the right. Simplify ear, tail and body internal shapes substantially compared with the reference. Balanced composition and strong silhouette. Retain a playful slight tilt, facial identity is the focus.
